name: afiya
description: Afiya Market — Telegram Mini App storefront (client) + order bot (server)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.ci:all: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix server ci --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server test
